integrity: All results concern relative projection constants of fixed cut and cycle subspaces. Averaging and general invariant-cycle-projection methods are acknowledged as prior literature. Previous canonical complete-multipartite endpoint values already entail the pointwise endpoint formulas and are not claimed new. The proposed new results are universal row-column symmetric global optimality, norm-wise comparison of optimum values, and sharp all-minimizers uniqueness classification for the cycle ell_1 case. Independent audit has not occurred; novelty can have uncatalogued antecedents.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for unweighted complete bipartite graphs with both parts of size at least two and ambient norms invariant under independent row/column permutations. Explicit rational endpoint constants apply to entrywise ell_1 and ell_infinity; interior p constants are given by an exact centering-norm factorization. No classification of all minimizers beyond uniqueness versus nonuniqueness for the cycle ell_1 range is asserted.
title: Symmetry-optimal biclique projections and the exceptional uniqueness of the square
